title: GetCurrentStageID - Quest
content:
Member of: Quest Script Obtains the highest completed stage in this Quest. Syntax: int Function GetCurrentStageID() native int Function GetStage() Parameters: None. Return Value: The highest completed stage in this Quest. Examples: ; Obtains the current stage int mainQuestStage = MainQuestProperty.GetCurrentStageID()
; Obtains the current stage int sideQuestStage = SideQuestProperty.GetStage() Notes: The GetCurrentStageID & GetStage functions both return the highest Quest stage completed. When a Quest that allows repeated stages regresses stages, the actual lower current stage value will not be returned. Use a script counter or Global. See Also: - Quest - Quest Script - IsStageDone - Quest - SetCurrentStageID - Quest
